For a first visit of two or three days, pick one or two among Alcatraz, a museum and a performance. One main activity a day leaves time for meals, navigation and jet lag.
第一步：决定要上恶魔岛，还是只想从船上看海湾: Step 1: decide between landing on Alcatraz and a sightseeing cruise
想进入牢房：从 NPS 官方入口进入 Alcatraz City Cruises: To enter the cellhouse, follow the NPS link to Alcatraz City Cruises, the only operator authorized to land visitors on the island. A sightseeing boat passing Alcatraz is a different product.
普通上岛船票包含往返船与牢房语音导览，可选普通话。NPS 说明可提前最多 90: Standard island tickets include the return ferry and cellhouse audio tour, with Mandarin available. NPS states tickets can be purchased up to 90 days ahead; check the official calendar for actual availability.
国家公园年票、长者票和免费日不抵扣恶魔岛船费。比较价格时看完整项目名称、年龄票种: National park annual or senior passes and fee-free days do not waive the Alcatraz ferry fare. Compare the full product, age category and checkout total; no park entrance fee does not mean a free ferry.
第二步：给恶魔岛留半天，先处理行李与上坡: Step 2: allow half a day and plan luggage and the climb
登船目的地设为 Pier 33 Alcatraz Landing，不要设成 PI: Navigate to Pier 33 Alcatraz Landing, rather than PIER 39. Allow about half a day and follow the arrival instructions in your confirmation, with extra buffer. Leave large luggage at your accommodation first. The dock-to-cellhouse route is about 0.4 km with 40 m of ascent; visitors with mobility impairments can check S.E.A.T. tram arrangements.
编辑建议：海滨日只围绕一个预约展开: Suggested waterfront day: build around one reservation
适合第一次认识城市海岸；每一段都可删减，不以步行走完全线为目标。: A first look at the city waterfront. Shorten any segment instead of trying to walk the entire route.
安排早餐与海湾散步，先检查去 Pier 33 的实际交通时间；如果船票较早，直接: Have breakfast and a short waterfront walk, checking the actual journey to Pier 33. For an early ferry booking, go straight to the landing.
保留登船、岛上参观与返航时间；岛后不要紧接另一张不可改时的门票。: Allow for boarding, the island visit and return sailing; avoid another inflexible timed ticket immediately afterward.
返航后｜Fisherman’s Wharf 或原路休息: After the ferry | Fisherman’s Wharf or a shorter return
按体力选一小段码头散步与晚餐，风大或疲倦就直接回住处。游船、水族馆和商业游乐项目: Choose a short wharf walk and dinner if you have energy; head back if tired or cold. Budget separately for cruises, aquariums and commercial attractions.
旧攻略修正：Hyde Street Pier 的历史船已不在原处: Old-guide correction: the historic ships have left Hyde Street Pier
NPS 的 2026 年 8 月说明确认，历史船已迁往 Vallejo 的 Ma: The NPS August 2026 update confirms the historic ships moved to Mare Island in Vallejo, with no settled return date during pier reconstruction. Keep an Aquatic Park waterfront stop, but do not promise a visit aboard Balclutha at Hyde Street Pier.
第三步：金门大桥选短走，不必走到对岸: Step 3: a short bridge walk can be enough
行人使用东侧人行道，西侧不是备用步行入口。十月仍处夏令时，官网常规列 05:00: Pedestrians use the east sidewalk; the west side is not an alternative walking entrance. Regular daylight-saving hours are listed as 5 AM–9 PM, but construction may close access an hour early. Plan daylight photos and a short out-and-back from the south end. In fog, enjoy bridge details or nearby parkland instead of waiting for a full-span view.
想减少交通支出，可查免费 Presidio GO。Downtown 线连接市中心: For lower transport costs, check Presidio GO. The Downtown route links downtown with Presidio Transit Center, with eligibility restrictions on some weekday commuter trips; South Hills is free for everyone. Neither is a door-to-door bridge service: check stops, the remaining walk and a backup return departure.
第四步：通票只按真正会去的付费项目比较: Step 4: compare passes against the paid visits you actually want
把每位同行者的年龄和已拥有的居民、图书馆或会员福利写下来，再查各场馆普通票。: List each traveler’s age and existing resident, library or membership benefits before comparing ordinary admission.
只把已决定去的付费景点算进通票价值，户外观景和免费公共展区按 $0 计。: Count only paid attractions you have chosen; outdoor viewpoints and free public galleries count as $0.
逐项核对预约要求、有效期、特展加价与取消条款；通票覆盖不等于热门时段有位。: Check reservation requirements, validity, special-exhibition charges and cancellation terms. Pass coverage does not guarantee a popular time slot.
第三天留给一个街区或公园；跨到 Muir Woods、Sausalito 或南湾: Leave day three for one neighborhood or park. Recalculate the round trip for Muir Woods, Sausalito or the South Bay instead of treating them as quick downtown add-ons.
